faq.question: What industries does XAIVON specialize in?
faq.answer: XAIVON specializes in logistics, supply chain, and data-heavy operations where repetitive manual tasks create operational bottlenecks.

faq.question: How does XAIVON pricing work?
faq.answer: Because business systems differ significantly, XAIVON prices projects based on architectural scope, system volume, and integration endpoints. Starter solutions generally begin from $499–$1,499, while full enterprise pipelines are scoped via a free operational audit.

faq.question: How long does deployment take?
faq.answer: Targeted automations and conversational assistants typically deploy in 1 to 2 weeks. Comprehensive cross-platform pipelines generally require 3 to 6 weeks including rigorous sandbox testing.

faq.question: How can I get started?
faq.answer: You can request a free workflow audit or contact Raja directly at raja@xaivon.com (+91-95211-90205) to evaluate your current bottlenecks.
